name: inprocess-obi-wb-uart-f5-refused
description: One Ibex OBI CPU reaches one real classic Wishbone ZipCPU UART that declares the four F5 facts. The F5 gate is asked whether this host has ever run an F5 cycle under the Wishbone target protocol; the case is refused by name before any model runs.
notes: This scenario is a question to the F5 protocol gate, not evidence of an F5 run.
The target is the real classic Wishbone wbuart (configs/peripherals/zipcpu_uart) behind beat_to_wishbone, with the two non-bus inputs rx=1 and cts_n=0 held by fixed_inputs.
The behavior file declares o_uart_tx_int, FIFO_STATUS at 0x04, a TXREG trigger write and no clear, so the declaration is complete enough for the F5 gate to be the only thing that can refuse it.
